title: Concept: Pyramid HTTP exception with its class path
description: A Pyramid httpexception rendered with its class path in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The class path names the framework and the exception family, which helps an attacker tell routing failures from view failures while mapping the app.
applicability: Deployments that render a Pyramid httpexception rendered with its class path into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The class path names the framework and the exception family, which helps an attacker tell routing failures from view failures while mapping the app.
